about: Goodsell Gallery（PDB-101）的全部画作：名字、标题、署名。页面写明 “These illustrations are free for use under CC-BY-4.0 license. Acknowledgement should be given as shown for each illustration.” 图在同目录下 <name>.jpg（800 像素宽，转成了 JPEG）；原尺寸在 https://cdn.rcsb.org/pdb101/goodsell/tif/<name>.tif。他给每幅写的说明在各自的页面上（https://pdb101.rcsb.org/sci-art/goodsell-gallery/<name>），许可里只说了插图，所以说明文字没有存在这里。 / Every painting of the Goodsell Gallery (PDB-101): name, title, acknowledgement. The page states: "These illustrations are free for use under CC-BY-4.0 license. Acknowledgement should be given as shown for each illustration." The images are <name>.jpg in this directory (800 pixels wide, converted to JPEG); full size is at https://cdn.rcsb.org/pdb101/goodsell/tif/<name>.tif. The description he gives each is on its own page (https://pdb101.rcsb.org/sci-art/goodsell-gallery/<name>); the licence speaks of the illustrations only, so the descriptions are not kept here.
